rules.title: Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income
rules.quote: Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income" added 9-18-2018 by O–20986 N.S.; effective 10-18-2018.
rules.summary: San Diego prohibits discrimination against tenants based on their source of income.
rules.effective_date_evidence: "Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income" added 9-18-2018 by O–20986 N.S.; effective 10-18-2018.
rules.coverage_text: Subject to exceptions for owner-occupied rental units under § 98.0804.
rules.exemption_note: Exceptions for owner-occupied rental units under § 98.0804.
